svg.title: Saurav Shrestha - Full-Stack Developer
svg.desc: Animated hero: full Klein Moretti throne portrait with slow zoom, rotating golden rune rings, pulsing glow and glint sweep, inside a tall camera viewfinder beside Saurav's name, cycling roles and live GitHub counts served fresh on every view.
svg.text: Turning error energy into fast, practical web apps,
THE FOOL WHO DOES NOT BELONG TO THIS ERA,
THE MYSTERIOUS RULER OF THE GRAY FOG,
THE BUILDER WHO TURNS ERRORS INTO WORKING CODE.
